What Is AdSpy Group Buy?

AdSpy group buy provides shared access to the largest Facebook ad database through SEO Group Buy Tools, reducing the cost from $149/month to $8-$20/month for competitive ad intelligence. AdSpy group buy allows multiple users to share a single AdSpy subscription.

The platform indexes over 100 million Facebook and Instagram ads, searchable by keyword, advertiser, landing page, and engagement metrics. SEO Group Buy Tools manages account access and provides credentials to subscribers. The shared model introduces session limitations since AdSpy restricts concurrent logins.
